report.explanation: All four services (gateway, order, payment, inventory) show identical healthy metrics: p95 72ms, error rate 0.001, zero db pool waiters, zero dependency timeouts, and flat memory retention. No telemetry supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert claims degraded checkout health but current read-only evidence contradicts it, so no bounded root cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Alert-specific telemetry or logs showing the actual degraded checkout symptom and its onset time
Per-service latency/error breakdown isolating which checkout dependency is affected
Deployment or configuration change records near the alert window
Dependency-level traces (redis, db, downstream) for checkout path
